# Soap: All locations including map (Burning Springs & Appalachia)

![Soap: All locations including map (Burning Springs & Appalachia)](/uploads/440_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Soap is frequently required in the daily and weekly **Challenges** in Fallout 76. You sometimes have to find 2 soaps or up to 14 soaps. You may already know some places, but sometimes it will be difficult to find **soap** on public worlds. Here you can use the map for soap and search for lesser-known places and still complete your challenge quickly. 

It also makes sense to regularly empty your **loot list**. You can read exactly how this works and what it entails here: Respawning items. Loot lists explained
